name: Neurobiology
description: Editable synapses, myelinated axons, glial contacts and generic neural circuit topologies with distinct biological forms.

source_records.statement: Original editable vector coordinates authored afresh for Figure Tool. Primary literature informs generic biological topology and interpretation limits only. No publication artwork, proprietary library object, screenshot, traced geometry, measured observations or third-party visual component was incorporated.

scientific_references.citation: Harris KM, Jensen FE, Tsao B. Three-dimensional structure of dendritic spines and synapses in rat hippocampus (CA1) at postnatal day 15 and adult ages. J Neurosci. 1992;12:2685–2705.
scientific_references.figure: Figures 3–4 (spine classes; thin, mushroom, and shaft synapses)
scientific_references.design_decision: Supports the distinction between presynaptic terminal, synaptic cleft, dendritic spine, and dendritic shaft; used only to set the biological topology, not to copy the illustrated geometry.

scientific_references.citation: Arizono M, et al. Structural basis of astrocytic Ca2+ signals at tripartite synapses. Nat Commun. 2020;11:1906.
scientific_references.figure: Figures 1, 3, and 8i (reticular meshwork; direct synapse contacts; tripartite-synapse schematic)
scientific_references.design_decision: Informed the distinction between a process contacting a bouton–spine synapse and a broader astrocytic process network; no activity or signaling effect is encoded.

scientific_references.citation: Almeida RG, Czopka T, Ffrench-Constant C, Lyons DA. Individual axons regulate the myelinating potential of single oligodendrocytes in vivo. Development. 2011;138:4443–4450.
scientific_references.figure: Figure 2 (single oligodendrocytes and multiple sheaths)
scientific_references.design_decision: Supports one oligodendrocyte soma extending several separate myelinating processes to axons; the drawn branches and axon positions are newly composed.

scientific_references.citation: Orita S, et al. Schwann cell LRP1 regulates Remak bundle ultrastructure and axonal interactions to prevent neuropathic pain. J Neurosci. 2013;33:5590–5602.
scientific_references.figure: Figures 2B and 3A (myelinated fiber; Remak bundle ultrastructure)
scientific_references.design_decision: Informed the separate one-axon myelinating internode and multiple small-axon nonmyelinating Remak bundle topologies; no pathology is depicted.

scientific_references.citation: Wake H, et al. Resting microglia directly monitor the functional state of synapses in vivo and determine the fate of ischemic terminals. J Neurosci. 2009;29:3974–3980.
scientific_references.figure: Figure 1
scientific_references.design_decision: Supports ramified surveying processes and direct, transient synaptic contacts. The asset uses a neutral contact mark and deliberately does not depict engulfment, elimination, or pruning.

scientific_references.citation: Sailamul P, Jang J, Paik SB. Synaptic convergence regulates synchronization-dependent spike transfer in feedforward neural networks. J Comput Neurosci. 2017;43:189–202.
scientific_references.figure: Figures 1 and 5 (feedforward network and convergence topology)
scientific_references.design_decision: Supports the topology of feedforward chains and convergent projections; arrows in this generic drawing show only direction and do not imply excitation or inhibition.
